cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/sez_random.py" -o /tmp/sez_random.py || { echo FETCH_FAIL; exit 1; }
rm -f /tmp/sez.log
nohup nice -n 19 timeout 1500 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/sez_random.py 400 > /tmp/sez.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 4; if ! pgrep -f sez_random.py >/dev/null; then break; fi; done
cat /tmp/sez.log | tail -n 14
